gen-fs-azeret-mono-montserrat: Technical through and through, Azeret Mono sets its fixed-width letters in wide, spaced-out words. Montserrat below it has a thickness that never shifts with direction, and its oversized e and a openings let the line glide like wire.
gen-fs-be-vietnam-pro-fs-karma: Clean lines, quiet confidence. Be Vietnam Pro holds one constant stroke width and leaves its curves open, while Karma, a serif, thins its arches slowly into lighter joins and sits tight between x-height and cap height.
gen-fs-be-vietnam-pro-roboto-slab: Marker-drawn and structured. Be Vietnam Pro traces every letter with one constant stroke, and Roboto Slab, a slab-serif, packs its weight into the middle of the line, so the two feel like a sketch next to a blueprint.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-montserrat: Montserrat opens things up with generous white space before each curve and a line that glides like wire. And Bespoke Slab, a serif with a high-set midline, brings the bookish dignity that this sans has no thick-thin modulation to offer.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and casual, its curves left unfinished like a pen lifted mid-loop. Bespoke Stencil stays commanding and industrial above it, so the body feels like a relaxed breath after something blunt, made for easy reading.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-fira-sans: Bespoke Stencil brings a commanding, industrial plainness, and Fira Sans answers with tube-like constant-weight lines and a larger-than-usual x-height. Its strongest quality is that clean split.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-public-sans: Commanding from the first glance, Bespoke Stencil is industrial and blunt at the top. Public Sans, a plain sans, does the quieter job below, with a hefty lowercase and broad counters that feel trustworthy.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-ranade: Ranade reads organic and spread out, with stroke ends set far apart and weight that shifts only slightly. But Bespoke Stencil's commanding, industrial heading against that loose sans is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-montserrat: Montserrat reads wide and friendly, with room before every curve. Against Bespoke Stencil's commanding, industrial heading, its joins stay full where strokes meet, and that sturdy shared feel is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-quicksand: Graceful and a bit sophisticated, Bevellier cuts its single-weight strokes tight, with a wide-looking lowercase. Quicksand, a sans, lets tall bowls like blown glass bulbs sit comfortably in small doses, and that soft contrast is the draw.
